app.title: 20 Tips
app.tagline: A guessing game for friends: one card, twenty tips, who gets it first?

home.notInvited: Not what you wanted? Create a room or type another code
how: Each round one player holds a card: a thing, a person, a place or a year, with 20 tips.
The other players take turns. On your turn, pick a tip number: the tip is shown to everybody, and you get one guess (or pass).
Guess right and you move 20 minus the number of tips shown so far; the card holder moves one space for each tip shown.
Example: a right guess after 5 tips moves the guesser 15 spaces and the card holder 5.
If all 20 tips are shown and nobody gets it, the card holder moves 20 spaces.

Some spaces of the board are special: move back or forward 5, back to the start, instant win, or an individual question (answer a card alone with up to 5 tips). They only act when you land on them by moving in a normal round.
The card then goes to the next player. First to reach the end of the track wins!

options.title: Game options
options.goalNote: Changing the board size puts the numbers of random special spaces back to their defaults for that size; a board of your own keeps the special spaces that still fit.
options.used: {n} of the {max} spaces between the start and the finish are special.
options.tooMany: Too many special spaces: the board has only {max} spaces between the start and the finish.
options.pointsNote: How many spaces each player moves.
options.nobody: Nobody gets it (all 20 tips shown): the card holder moves
options.individualNote: The card holder never moves in an individual question. A wrong answer moves nobody.
options.timeNote: When the time to pick a tip runs out, a tip is picked at random. When the time to guess runs out, the player passes automatically. The clock waits for a player who is away.
options.boardHow: How the special spaces are placed
options.modeRandomHint: Drawn at random when the game starts, in the numbers you choose.
options.modeCustomHint: You place each special space yourself.
options.editorHint: Click a space to change it: normal → ❓ → −5 → +5 → 💀 → 🏆 → normal.
options.summaryCustom: Board of {n} spaces, made by the host
